name: Soumen Ray

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Soumen Roy is the author of the novel Scar and the poetry collection Lyrical Musings. Both titles were reviewed by Literoma in January 2023. Penprints lists Scar in its 2022 catalogue; Lyrical Musings appeared with Notion Press in 2022.

His brief Kabita Live poem “DUSK AND DAWN” places contrasting moods within the changing light of a single landscape. Laughter and weariness give way to grey and crimson images of hurt. Repeated sounds and the return to dusk and dawn bind these abrupt emotional shifts into a small, unsettled cycle.
